cppcheck_raw_diagnostics.note: The raw count includes transitive SDK, vendor, and kernel-header locations; the Sonar issue API reports 129 missing-system-header issues on indexed CIX components.

genuine_correctness_defects.finding: The contract's database open and decoder-size calls occur only inside assert. A release/NDEBUG build can skip those calls and invalidate the contract's intended checks.
genuine_correctness_defects.bounded_fix: Evaluate each status-producing call before the assertion, then assert/check the stored result. Preserve the manager/reopen/decode sequence.

configuration_or_false_positive_with_evi.evidence: shift starts at zero and advances only by seven; the loop accepts only shifts 0, 7, 14, 21, and 28. At shift 28 it rejects payload values above 15 before the shift. The reported shift 34 is infeasible.
configuration_or_false_positive_with_evi.next_action: Retain the bounded decoder; if desired, make the five-byte bound syntactically explicit only after the frozen scan.
